source.title: Orthogonal Polynomials and Operator Theory. Open Problems and Applications

trace.notes: Normalized one URL input. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/7949093 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403 in the local fetch attempt, so zbMATH was treated as a bibliographic resolver rather than a readable technical source.

Workspace resolver metadata identified zbMATH document 7949093 as DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-62025-6_7 with the title Orthogonal polynomials and operator theory. Open problems and applications. Crossmark/Springer metadata confirmed the exact work as the chapter Orthogonal Polynomials and Operator Theory. Open Problems and Applications by Edmundo J. Huertas and Francisco Marcellán, first online 26 August 2024, in Cutting-Edge Mathematics.

The Springer chapter page exposed only title, authors, abstract, references, acknowledgements, and citation metadata. It explicitly stated that the page is a preview of subscription content and offered purchase/subscription access; the visible page did not contain the chapter's problem statements.
The direct Springer PDF endpoint for DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-62025-6_7 redirected through Springer identity/cookie handling and ended at the HTML chapter preview rather than a readable PDF artifact.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched for the DOI plus PDF, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title alone, and the exact title with the authors. Candidate pages inspected or identified were Springer chapter/book pages, Crossmark DOI metadata, the author's publication list pointing back to Springer, and unrelated or snippet-only search results. No candidate was accepted because none provided a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.
